entries.title: Psalms 65:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm [and] Song of David.>> Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed. {waiteth: Heb. is silent}

words.text: : and unto thee shall the vow

entries.title: Psalms 65:2
segments: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

entries.title: Psalms 65:3
segments: Iniquities prevail against me: [as for] our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away. {iniquities: Heb. Words, or, Matters of iniquities}

words.text: . {iniquities: Heb. Words, or, Matters of iniquities}

entries.title: Psalms 65:4
segments: Blessed [is the man whom] thou choosest, and causest to approach [unto thee, that] he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, [even] of thy holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 65:5
segments: [By] terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; [who art] the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off [upon] the sea:

words.text: , and of them that are afar off

entries.title: Psalms 65:6
segments: ¶Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; [being] girded with power:

entries.title: Psalms 65:7
segments: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 65:8
segments: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice. {rejoice: or, sing}

entries.title: Psalms 65:9
segments: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, [which] is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it. {and...: or, after thou hadst made it to desire rain}

words.text: for it. {and...: or, after thou hadst made it to desire rain}

entries.title: Psalms 65:10
segments: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof. {settlest: or, causest rain to descend into} {makest...: Heb. dissolvest it}

words.text: thereof. {settlest: or, causest rain to descend into} {makest...: Heb. dissolvest it}

entries.title: Psalms 65:11
segments: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness. {with: Heb. of}

entries.title: Psalms 65:12
segments: They drop [upon] the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side. {rejoice...: Heb. are girded with joy}

entries.title: Psalms 65:13
segments: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
